units: Pes. 107ᵃ ומה פ׳ דבעאי וכ׳ Ar. (ed. פיר׳; Ms. M. פורזימא, Ms. M. 2 פורזמא; the words in ed. a. Mss. between פ׳ a. דבעאי, are a gloss to פ׳, read as in Ms. O. שכר תאיני ואסיני) since I asked … even with regard to pirzuma (which is superior to barley beer) &c.

senses.gloss: פ׳ דשיכרא the second run of barley beer.
